patterns.message: Creator code must never import admin code. The admin hooks flatten brand_commercials (client name, allocated budget, spend) onto their rows so the approve dialog can price a decision, and staff and creators are both the `authenticated` database role, so one import here is all it takes to put a commercial column on a creator's screen. Anything genuinely shared belongs in a neutral file: src/lib/work/, src/lib/content.ts, src/lib/money.ts or src/lib/offer-stages.ts.
Creator code must never import an admin screen. Move the shared piece into src/components/work/ and pass anything staff-only in as a prop.

Admin code must never import a creator screen: it drags creator code into the admin bundle, which is exactly what the admin content screen used to do with ContentCard. Move the shared piece into src/components/work/, where it takes everything staff-only as a prop and decides nothing about who is looking.
Admin code must never import creator hooks. Anything shared belongs in a neutral file such as src/lib/work/.
